title: Cross-school student transfers
subtitle: Requests built on MINESEC identity, primary guardian consent and a secured pre-transfer dossier

categories.IDENTITY: Student identity (full name, MINESEC national ID, date of birth)
categories.ATTENDANCE_SUMMARY: Attendance summary per academic year (justified / unjustified)

staff.page_subtitle: Check a MINESEC national ID, follow your requests and review the history of students who arrived by transfer
staff.verifier_help: Enter the student's MINESEC national ID. If that ID is already attached to another school, a transfer will be proposed instead of a usual enrolment.
staff.detect_ok: This national ID is already attached to another school. Create a transfer request rather than a fresh enrolment.
staff.detect_libre: No existing attachment: enrol the student normally (New dossier).
staff.annuler_confirmer_texte: The request will become “Cancelled”: the guardian will no longer follow it from the SMS link received.
staff.creer_dialogue_texte: Once created, the student's verified primary guardian will receive an SMS link with a code. Without them, no transfer.
staff.annee_cible_label: Academic year targeted by the transfer
staff.creer_ok: Request created: the guardian has been notified by SMS.
staff.doublon_actif: An active request already exists for this identity.
staff.matricule_inconnu: No recorded identity for this national ID.
staff.matricule_invalide: Invalid national ID: alphanumeric characters only.
staff.fonctionnalite_off: Cross-school transfer is disabled for this school.
staff.associer_texte: Choose your own school's student profile that received this dossier (enrolled with the same national ID).
staff.associer_ok: Profile linked to the transfer dossier.
staff.associer_deja: This dossier already has its receiving profile linked.
staff.message_refus: Reason requested by the family or the origin school
staff.historique_subtitle: Dossiers received from another school — read-only, origin school and date displayed
staff.historique_censure_note: Read-only: this dossier belongs to the origin school and can never be modified here.
staff.dossier_erreur_integrite: The dossier has been tampered with: integrity not verified.

admin.page_subtitle: Requests received from other schools: guardian consent state, auto-approval countdown, acceptance or motivated refusal
admin.consentement_attente: The guardian has not answered yet via the SMS link received
admin.delai_auto: Auto-approval in {jours} day(s) if no action
admin.accept_valide: Transfer accepted: the dossier will be handed over to your school.
admin.refuser_motif_placeholder: e.g. target class at full capacity
admin.refus_refuse: Request refused: the family will be notified.

tuteur.revoquer_texte: As long as the transfer is not completed, you can withdraw your agreement: the request will be marked revoked and can no longer move forward.
tuteur.categories_intro: If you accept, only the following list of data will be transferred
tuteur.revoquer_erreur: Revocation failed: the transfer is already completed or the link expired.
tuteur.otp_invalide: Invalid code or expired / already-used link.
tuteur.erreur_generique: Cannot reach the server. Try again while connected to the internet.
tuteur.champs_manquants: Incomplete link: the security code is missing in the address.
